Consumer 1 · OpalReturns
A PSP-agnostic returns module on Payment Base

OpalReturns is the proof:
a real consumer, zero PSP imports.

OpalReturns handles refund & return workflows across every PSP — Stripe, PayPal, future providers — without ever importing PSP-specific code. Architecture invariant enforced by grep guards: no OxidEsales\Payments\Stripe or OxidEsales\Payments\PayPal references in opalreturns/src/.

The three patterns OpalReturns uses
A
Subscribe to PaymentRefundedEvent
PSP-agnostic. Whether the refund came from Stripe or PayPal, the event is the same shape. OpalReturns’ ReturnHandler hooks the event and triggers the return workflow.
B
Contract metadata for return-specific data
Return reason, RMA number, restocking-fee policy — stored on the Smart-Contract via setMetadata(). Survives the lifecycle, queryable via the contract repository.
C
Resolution broker via tagged services
Tag: opalreturns.resolution_handler. PSP-specific resolution logic lives in each PSP module, not in OpalReturns. Broker is the only fan-out point — same pattern as oe.payment.admin_panel and oe.payment.event_translator.
The lesson: a downstream module never reaches into a PSP. PSP-specific code goes in the PSP module under a tag the downstream module collects. Three real registries in production today: oe.payment.admin_panel, opalreturns.resolution_handler, oe.payment.event_translator.
